3) Status: Success

5) Player: "Cheon Ssang In" and "Trexxx" on the Korean server

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Previously released in 2014 as a "cove" drop on GAMA server, this unisex/color custom outfit is yet to be re-released on Maris server in any coves or cash shops. But it appears you can create it. Great find, Beomi; my thanks to you and Cheon Ssang In and Trexxx for sharing this info. Cheers!
